card.name: Start of split words like SUSPECTED, EMBOLISM
card.fires_on: The first or middle piece of a long word split into parts, such as SUS in SUSPECTED, EM in THROMBOEMBOLISM, Im in Implant, and em in emollients. It is seen mostly in label headings and warnings.

modes.label: Capitalised heading words
modes.description: A piece inside an all-caps label heading, such as SUS or EM.

modes.label: Lowercase em/Im pieces
modes.description: The opening piece of words like implant, emollients or emasculated.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing a split word with the right ending, though the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the opening chunk of a long word that the model reads in pieces, such as SUSPECTED or THROMBOEMBOLISM.
